genericProblem: A package admission control couples the exact evidence denominator to the entire future implementation path set and has no recoverable control-plane branch when its own package file is malformed.
searchedSurfaces: tools/compliance-control/cli.mjs readActivePackage, allowed, hook-pre, hook-post, deltaState
counterexamples: A control-only package with a deliberately single immutable file may retain an exact-only surface, but it still needs an explicit recovery policy if its own pointer is mutable.

findings.genericProblem: Malformed active package prevents both diagnosis and authorized repair.
findings.applicability: Packages with a mutable active package and PreToolUse validation.

findings.genericProblem: Exact evidence paths are incorrectly treated as the complete implementation authorization denominator.
findings.applicability: Implementation packages whose same-root owner/test files can be discovered after admission.

preventionDispositions.owningSourceOrControl: tools/compliance-control/cli.mjs active-package recovery request/command and red/green self-test
